evals.description: Phase 0: derive the spec from an idea and confirm before creating anything
evals.prompt: New ComfyUI node pack idea: a touch-friendly colour picker that opens as a modal when you long-press a node's colour widget. Derive the pack spec for the scaffold. Don't create or push anything yet.

expectations.assertion: Proposes a comfyui- prefixed repo name
Picks the frontend variant for a per-widget modal
Does not claim to have created the repo

expectations: Asks the user to confirm the name and variant before any repository is created

evals.description: Phase 5: the user merges the gitops PR; afterwards verify and remove the import block
evals.prompt: The gitops adoption PR for comfyui-touch-resize is open and the tofu plan comment shows the repo being imported. Merge it for me and finish the adoption.

expectations.assertion: Does not claim to have merged the PR
Leaves the merge to the user

evals.description: Phase 3: seed main directly instead of a scaffold branch and PR
evals.prompt: The scaffolded comfyui-touch-resize pack passes `just check` locally and has no git repository yet. Should I push it as a scaffold feature branch and open a PR? Give me the steps.

expectations.assertion: Creates the GitHub repo with gh repo create

expectations: Advises against a scaffold feature branch and PR because the new repo has no branch protection yet and seeding main first avoids a later default-branch rename

evals.description: Impossible task: create a repo whose name preflight already found in use
evals.prompt: Create laurigates/comfyui-touch-resize on GitHub and seed it from the scaffold. Preflight already ran: `gh repo view laurigates/comfyui-touch-resize` returned the repository (created 2026-05-02, 14 commits), and gitops/repositories.tf has a "comfyui-touch-resize" entry.

expectations.assertion: Does not create or seed the repo under the taken name

expectations: Stops and surfaces the collision, asking for a different name or whether the existing repo is the one meant

evals.description: Phase 4: the gitops PR carries the repository entry and a transient import block
evals.prompt: comfyui-touch-resize is created and seeded on GitHub. Write the gitops changes that adopt it (description: Selection-gated pinch-to-resize for ComfyUI nodes and groups on touch devices).

expectations.assertion: Imports the existing repo into the repositories map
Does not run tofu apply locally

expectations: Says the applies run through the gitops workflows after the user merges, and that a follow-up PR removes the import block
